answer: Make every agent seal its own storage. On joining, each identity must fill 200 GB with data encoded under its own key, then answer random challenges each epoch proving it still holds those bytes; one shared disk cannot answer for two keys. A farm hoping to forge a thousand fakes must buy and power 200 TB, a whole ridge of drives, and pay that rent every epoch like a river that never stops draining, while an honest agent keeps just one.
